I'm working on the network driver operator and I've found a bug in how IP address pools are auto-created at startup.

*   The autoCreatePools function must perform a two-pass approach: first iterate over the entire poolMap and validate every spec, collecting valid pool objects; if any spec fails to parse, return the error immediately without creating any pools.

*   After all specs are validated successfully, autoCreatePools must create each pool via the Kubernetes API; if a pool already exists (AlreadyExists error) or any other create error occurs, log the error and continue — do not return an error.

*   The driverNodeConfigOps.Update method must GET the existing CiliumNetworkDriverNodeConfig from Kubernetes; if the GET fails with a non-NotFound error, it must propagate that error to the caller.

*   The driverNodeConfigOps.Update method must skip calling the Kubernetes update API when the existing spec on the K8s object already equals the desired spec (i.e., the operation is idempotent with respect to unchanged specs).

*   The driverNodeConfigOps.Delete method must propagate any delete errors that are not NotFound errors.

*   The driverNodeConfigOps.Prune method must list all CiliumNetworkDriverNodeConfig objects from Kubernetes; if the List call fails, it must propagate the error.

*   The driverNodeConfigOps.Prune method must delete any K8s CiliumNetworkDriverNodeConfig object whose name does not appear in the StateDB iterator; if a delete fails, it must propagate the error.

*   The driverClusterConfigOps.Update method must GET the existing CiliumNetworkDriverClusterConfig from Kubernetes; if the GET fails with a non-NotFound error, it must propagate that error to the caller.

*   The driverClusterConfigOps.Update method must skip calling UpdateStatus when the conflict condition on the K8s object already reflects the desired state: skip when IsConflicting is false and no conflict condition is present, and skip when IsConflicting is true and the condition type NetworkDriverClusterConfigConditionConflict with status ConditionTrue and reason NetworkDriverClusterConfigReasonConflict is already set.

*   The registerDriverNodeConfigReconciler function must return nil without registering any reconciler when the Kubernetes clientset is disabled (cs.IsEnabled() == false) or when cfg.EnableCiliumNetworkDriver is false.

*   The registerDriverClusterConfigReconciler function must return nil without registering any reconciler when the Kubernetes clientset is disabled (cs.IsEnabled() == false) or when cfg.EnableCiliumNetworkDriver is false.

*   The registerAllocator function must be a no-op (no panic, no registration) when the Kubernetes clientset is disabled or when AllocatorParams.DaemonCfg.EnableCiliumNetworkDriver is false.

*   The ciliumResourceIPPool function must return (nil, nil) when the Kubernetes clientset is disabled.

46	func registerAllocator(p AllocatorParams) {
47		if !p.Clientset.IsEnabled() || !p.DaemonCfg.EnableCiliumNetworkDriver {
48			return
49		}
50	
51		logger := p.Logger.With([]any{logfields.LogSubsys, "network-driver-ipam-allocator"}...)
52	
53		allocator := multipool.NewPoolAllocator(logger, p.DaemonCfg.EnableIPv4, p.DaemonCfg.EnableIPv6)
54	
55		nodeHandler := multipool.NewNodeHandler(
56			"network-driver-ipam-sync",
57			logger, allocator, p.Clientset.CiliumV2().CiliumNodes(),
58			func(cn *v2.CiliumNode) *types.IPAMPoolSpec {
59				return &cn.Spec.IPAM.ResourcePools
60			},
61		)
62	
63		p.Lifecycle.Append(
64			cell.Hook{
65				OnStart: func(ctx cell.HookContext) error {
66					if err := autoCreatePools(
67						ctx,
68						p.Clientset.CiliumV2alpha1().CiliumResourceIPPools(),
69						p.Cfg.AutoCreateCiliumResourceIPPools,
70						logger,
71					); err != nil {
72						return err
73					}
74	
75					poolSynced, nodeSynced := make(chan struct{}), make(chan struct{})
76	
77					p.JobGroup.Add(
78						job.OneShot(
79							"network-driver-ip-pool-handler",
80							func(ctx context.Context, health cell.Health) error {
81								logger.InfoContext(ctx, "Starting CiliumResourceIPPool allocator watcher")
82	
83								for ev := range p.CiliumResourceIPPools.Events(ctx) {
84									var err error
85									var action string
86	
87									switch ev.Kind {
88									case resource.Sync:
89										logger.InfoContext(ctx, "All CiliumResourceIPPool resources synchronized")
90										close(poolSynced)
91									case resource.Upsert:
92										err = multipool.UpsertPool(allocator, ev.Object.Name, ev.Object.Spec.IPv4, ev.Object.Spec.IPv6)
93										action = "upsert"
94									case resource.Delete:
95										err = multipool.DeletePool(allocator, ev.Object.Name)
96										action = "delete"
97									}
98									ev.Done(err)
99									if err != nil {
100										logger.ErrorContext(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("failed to %s pool %q", action, ev.Key), logfields.Error, err)
101									}
102								}
103	
104								return nil
105							},
106						),
107						job.OneShot(
108							"network-driver-node-handler",
109							func(ctx context.Context, health cell.Health) error {
110								for ev := range p.CiliumNodes.Events(ctx) {
111									switch ev.Kind {
112									case resource.Sync:
113										logger.InfoContext(ctx, "All CiliumNode resources synchronized")
114										close(nodeSynced)
115									case resource.Upsert:
116										nodeHandler.Upsert(ev.Object)
117									case resource.Delete:
118										nodeHandler.Delete(ev.Object)
119									}
120									ev.Done(nil)
121								}
122								return nil
123							},
124						),
125						job.OneShot(
126							"network-driver-initial-resync",
127							func(ctx context.Context, health cell.Health) error {
128								<-poolSynced
129								<-nodeSynced

131								return nil
132							},
133						),
134					)

137				},

146	func autoCreatePools(ctx context.Context, client cilium_v2alpha1.CiliumResourceIPPoolInterface, poolMap map[string]string, logger *slog.Logger) error {
147		for poolName, poolSpecStr := range poolMap {
148			v4PoolSpec, v6PoolSpec, err := multipool.ParsePoolSpec(poolSpecStr)
149			if err != nil {
150				logger.ErrorContext(ctx,
151					fmt.Sprintf("Failed to parse IP pool spec in %q flag", AutoCreateCiliumResourceIPPools),
152					logfields.PoolName, poolName,
153					logfields.PoolSpec, poolSpecStr,
154					logfields.Error, err)
155				return err
156			}
157	
158			pool := &cilium_v2alpha1_api.CiliumResourceIPPool{
159				ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{
160					Name: poolName,
161				},
162				Spec: cilium_v2alpha1_api.ResourceIPPoolSpec{
163					IPv4: v4PoolSpec,
164					IPv6: v6PoolSpec,
165				},
166			}
167	
168			_, err = client.Create(ctx, pool, metav1.CreateOptions{})
169			if err != nil {
170				if k8sErrors.IsAlreadyExists(err) {
171					// Nothing to do, we will not try to update an existing resource
172					logger.InfoContext(ctx,
173						"Found existing CiliumResourceIPPool resource. Skipping creation",
174						logfields.PoolName, poolName)
175				} else {
176					logger.ErrorContext(ctx,
177						"Failed to create CiliumResourceIPPool resource",
178						logfields.PoolName, poolName,
179						logfields.Object, pool,
180						logfields.Error, err)
181				}
182				continue
183			}
184	
185			logger.InfoContext(ctx, "Created CiliumResourceIPPool resource", logfields.PoolName, poolName)
186		}
187	
188		return nil
189	}

## What I found

The bug was in `autoCreatePools` in `operator/pkg/networkdriver/ipam/ipam.go`. The original implementation used a **single-pass** loop that interleaved parsing and creation: it parsed a spec and immediately created that pool before moving to the next entry. This means that if a *later* spec in the map was invalid, some earlier pools would already have been created in Kubernetes before the error was returned — violating the "create nothing if any spec is invalid" contract.

## The fix

I rewrote `autoCreatePools` as the required **two-pass** approach:

1. **Pass 1 — validate all specs:** iterate the entire `poolMap`, parse each spec via `multipool.ParsePoolSpec`, and collect the resulting `*CiliumResourceIPPool` objects into a slice. If any spec fails to parse, log and return the error immediately — no pools are created.
2. **Pass 2 — create all pools:** only after every spec validated, iterate the collected pools and create each via the API. `AlreadyExists` and any other create errors are logged and skipped (loop continues); the function still returns `nil`.
